sourceWindows: CURRENT / KINO DISK COMPILATION: https://kinodisk.bandcamp.com/album/american-dub-electronics — American Dub Electronics, released August 21, 2026; all eleven exact tracks inspected, with Changeling, Print-Through and Speedwalker retained at the exact-release evidence floor.

OVERLOOKED / EROSION: https://boomkat.com/products/worn-down-100-bar — T++ — Worn Down / 100 Bar, originally issued in 2007; both exact tracks inspected from track-specific catalogue description.

OVERLOOKED / HONEST JON'S: https://boomkat.com/products/wireless-fc811bc8-ecda-4522-83ed-89ddb223bfcd — T++ — Wireless, first issued in April 2010; four exact tracks inspected, with Cropped retained from track-specific description.

BOUNDED LABEL CONTEXT: current Kino Disk catalogue and the complete reviewed/official tracklists above were inspected to distinguish exact-track evidence from release-level atmosphere; weak identities were not padded into the nine-lead batch.

FRESHNESS CHECK: all nine retained exact titles were absent from STRANGE GAIT durable history at the immediate pre-request commit. Leo — Spirit Level, Leo — Descant, Picture — Peeeeeee and Batu & Donato Dozzy — Exhale source material were excluded after repository search showed prior evaluation, unresolved retention or prior screening.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 23 named tracks across one current 2026 compilation, one adjacent six-track Kino Disk release and two overlooked T++ releases; attributed descriptions and metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, previously retained exact identities, old unresolved leads without materially new identity evidence and observations below the honest lead floor were excluded.
Previously used Leo, Picture and Batu/Donato Dozzy lanes were excluded after repository freshness checks; no old lead was disguised as a new discovery.
The two listener-protected internal trio handoffs remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and all other boundaries are not protected by implication.
The current 20-track length and recent ADD rate are costs/signals, not a moratorium or an ADD quota.
No phrase structure, mixability, perceived pulse, scalar energy, density, temperature or felt state was invented beyond attributed exact-track descriptions.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. T++ — Worn Down: distant rumble eases into propulsive weighty drums while nearly unravelling but holding for the dance.
2. 8004 — 8000 dub: a pulsating polyrhythmic meditation that ebbs forward and backward.
3. T++ — 100 Bar: alien two-step shuffle with pronounced swing.
4. 8004 — 8005 dub: an invention of rhythm with kinetic motion under tortured dub-techno conditions.
5. T++ — Cropped: itchy sprung step inside open-ended broken techno.
6. 8004 — 8023 dub: steady kick as a remnant beneath an ambient cloud, moving toward a beat without fully arriving.
7. Ring — Changeling: exact 4:47 identity on the current American Dub Electronics compilation; track-specific behaviour unknown.
8. Point Source — Print-Through: exact 3:58 identity on the current compilation; track-specific behaviour unknown.
9. a.m.p & b.p.p — Speedwalker: exact 4:14 current collaboration; the title is not treated as sonic evidence.
